messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: The effects of albuterol inhalation should last about 4 to 6 hours.
Seek medical attention if you think your asthma medications are not working as well.
An increased need for medication could be an early sign of a serious asthma attack.
Use the dose counter on your albuterol inhaler device.
Get your prescription refilled before you run out of medicine completely.
Always use the new inhaler device provided with your refill.
Do not float a medicine canister in water to see if medicine canister is empty.
ProAir HFA, Proventil HFA, or Ventolin HFA must be shaken before each use.
You do not need to shake ProAir RespiClick before using.
Follow all product instructions on how to clean your albuterol inhaler device and mouthpiece.
Do not wash or put any part of the ProAir RespiClick inhaler device in water.
Replace your inhaler if it is washed or placed in water.
If the mouthpiece needs cleaning, gently wipe mouthpiece with a dry cloth or tissue.
Do not use a spacer or volume holding chamber with ProAir RespiClick.
Asthma is often treated with a combination of drugs.

B. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
